title: finding(app-shell/inspectors,i18n): the dashboard widget inspector's field combo shows the English literal `Search fields…` as its search placeholder — `engine.form.searchFields` exists in en-US and zh-CN and its sibling inspector reads it
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site (class a), read from source with a lit control. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 5 (`session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`) from the at-tier contract review of PR objectui#10678 (objectui#10586, merged as `d02974d`), which named it as out of scope. The seat re-read it on objectui `origin/main` `7afc81d`. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## Fact

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx:442` passes `searchPlaceholder="Search fields…"` to `InspectorComboField` as a string literal.
- Every other label in the same inspector goes through `t('engine.inspector.…', locale)`. Its dataset combo's placeholder does too (`:339-340`).
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` already carries `engine.form.searchFields`: `'Search fields…'` in en-US (`:1319`) and `'搜索字段…'` in zh-CN (`:3594`).
- ⇒ A zh-CN author opening a dashboard widget's field picker reads the English `Search fields…` on an otherwise translated inspector.

**Lit control:** `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx:579` and `:633` pass `searchPlaceholder={tr('engine.form.searchFields')}` to the same combo, and render `搜索字段…` under zh-CN.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Read the existing `engine.form.searchFields` key there, the way `DatasetDefaultInspector` does. No new key is needed, which keeps the objectui#4662 `engine.*` carve-out (en-US and zh-CN only) untouched.

## Dedupe

Searched this repo with the MCP semantic issue search, including closed issues: `DashboardWidgetInspector Search fields English placeholder untranslated` ⇒ objectui#9652 (closed; the designer's unknown-value markers, a different literal), objectui#4748 (closed; `WidgetConfigPanel` in `plugin-dashboard`, a different surface) and older closed i18n cards. None covers this literal, and the hits show the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `DashboardWidgetInspector Search fields English` · `widget inspector searchPlaceholder literal` · `engine.form.searchFields unread`
